decision_notes: The council website designates its YouTube service. Selected recordings of 437th extraordinary session, first and second plenaries were visually reviewed in Chromium and WebKit with advancing decoded video. Gyeongsangnam samples show a member delivering a five-minute speech and another member approaching the lectern during ordinary chamber proceedings, with inset interpreters. This confirms the selected recordings, not current live or every committee/room. Some provider recordings are labelled auto-dubbed; muted tests do not verify audio-track selection.

Official council website link only. Its own site designates the video provider. No current, separate audiovisual reuse permission was established by the reviewed institutional/video navigation and search. Retain permission pending and do not embed, rehost or export provider streams.
